jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation key drawings for XiaoWu A-01. Input image is the exact identity, costume, palette and painting-style reference. Delicate polished anime chibi painting, long flowing dark chocolate hair, small black half-up ribbon, brown eyes, cream ruffled blouse with charcoal suspenders and tiny heart pendant, charcoal wide trousers and black shoes. Create EXACTLY EIGHT full-body character drawings in a perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS animation sprite sheet, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Large high resolution canvas, ideally 3072x2048. Eight equally sized invisible cells, each with generous transparent margin and same character scale. Lock camera angle, torso center, head shape, hair mass, leg position and foot baseline in every cell. Actual transparent background, no floor shadow, no text, no cell borders, no effects, no duplicate limbs. Each cell contains exactly one complete character with uncut feet and hair. This is a coherent temporal sequence, not unrelated illustrative poses. Carefully draw real limb articulation; preserve five fingers and consistent hands. Standing in a fixed frontal three-quarter view, both feet stay planted, left arm resting at side throughout. A COMPLETE friendly wave: cell 1 both arms down relaxed with soft smile; cell 2 right elbow begins bending and right hand reaches waist; cell 3 right hand rises to chest with open palm; cell 4 right palm beside cheek tilted toward face, elbow bent; cell 5 right forearm and open palm sweep outward away from face by 25 degrees; cell 6 right forearm and palm swing back inward toward cheek; cell 7 right hand lowers to chest halfway down; cell 8 right arm rests at side again matching cell 1. Keep still body and head throughout; only right shoulder/elbow/wrist articulate naturally. Hand positions must be clearly different and sequential. Do not merely bend pixels or tilt the whole character.
